forbidden_behaviors.description: Replay, trace, and eval projections must not expose raw prompts or user input payloads.
forbidden_behaviors.expected_guard: guard_redacted_payload rejects raw prompt aliases and replay API projection remains sanitized.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Replay artifacts must not expose raw tool args, raw tool payloads, descriptors, or unsafe upstream output.
forbidden_behaviors.expected_guard: Tool policy and replay redaction negatives reject raw tool payload aliases before append or projection.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Ticket, order, refund, buyer, credential, API key, and secret aliases must not appear in replay payloads.
forbidden_behaviors.expected_guard: Phase 35 redaction negatives reject PII and secret aliases recursively.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Action draft replay events must expose stable refs and hashes, not raw proposed action payloads.
forbidden_behaviors.expected_guard: Action draft event payloads are hash/ref based and raw action payload aliases are rejected.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Business-data trace, replay, run status, evidence, and stream views must remain owner/admin-only in Phase 35.
forbidden_behaviors.expected_guard: Phase 35 permission regressions deny non-owner support, manager, merchant, supervisor, and approval_manager users.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Cross-tenant trace/replay lookups must fail closed and not expose run existence.
forbidden_behaviors.expected_guard: Replay and trace API tests keep cross-tenant access at not-found semantics.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Same-tenant cross-merchant or requested_by merchant shortcuts must not open trace/replay access.
forbidden_behaviors.expected_guard: Static/API permission tests prove target merchant proof is projection-only and not an authorization shortcut.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Unsupported user-visible or action-bound claims must be blocked before risk, approval, or action draft paths.
forbidden_behaviors.expected_guard: Claim verification and risk tests fail closed on unsupported action-bound claims.

forbidden_behaviors.description: No-evidence RAG or claim verification states must not produce deterministic action recommendations.
forbidden_behaviors.expected_guard: RAG/claim/risk tests route insufficient evidence to refusal or manual review without proposed actions.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Unsafe, unbound, or insufficiently authorized action paths must not reach approval or action draft creation.
forbidden_behaviors.expected_guard: Risk/action draft tests require claim, evidence, business fact, target merchant, payload hash, and safety snapshot bindings.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Stale BusinessFactRefV1 values must not enter action-bound risk, approval, or draft paths.
forbidden_behaviors.expected_guard: Business fact and risk/action tests fail closed when current business fact authority is unavailable or stale.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Wrong-scope BusinessFactRefV1 values must not satisfy action safety or target merchant binding.
forbidden_behaviors.expected_guard: Approval/action binding tests reject merchant or scope mismatches before draft creation.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Invalid-scope evidence must not enter prompt authority, claim support, risk, approval, or action draft paths.
forbidden_behaviors.expected_guard: RAG context build and claim verification tests reject invalid-scope evidence before action routing.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Approval payload hash mismatches must not create action drafts.
forbidden_behaviors.expected_guard: Action draft binding tests reject approval or auto-allowed payload hash mismatches and persist no drafts.
